findings.source_quote: “And he shall be like a tree planted by the rivers of water, that bringeth forth his fruit in his season; his leaf also shall not wither; and whatsoever he doeth shall prosper” (Psalms 1:3).
findings.suggested_fix:
Badilisha mstari uliotafsiriwa ndani ya

kwa tafsiri inayofanana na Kiingereza awali. Pendekezo: “Na atakuwa kama mti uliopandwa kando ya mito ya maji, ambao hutoa matunda yake kwa msimu wake; jani lake halitauka; na atakayefanya atafanikiwa.” (Zaburi 1:3).
findings.translation_quote: “Na atakuwa kama mti uliopandwa kando ya mito ya maji, ambao hutoa matunda yake kwa msimu wake; jani lake halitauka; na atakaye kosa atafanikiwa” (Zaburi 1:3).

findings.source_quote: “In 1 John 1:9 God has said that if we confess our sins, He will forgive us.”
findings.suggested_fix:
Sahihisha sentensi ndani ya

ili kuonyesha maana sahihi ya Kiingereza. Pendekezo: “Katika 1 Yohana 1:9 Mungu amesema kwamba ikiwa tutatamka/tukatambua dhambi zetu (tukatuhumu dhambi zetu kwa uwazi) atatusamehe.” Au, kwa ufupisho na usahihi wa moja kwa moja: “Katika 1 Yohana 1:9 Mungu amesema kwamba tukitubu na kukiri dhambi zetu, atatusamehe.” (Tumia neno “kukiri” au “kutitaja” badala ya “kutuhumiwa”.)
findings.translation_quote: “Katika 1 Yohana 1:9 Mungu amesema kwamba tukituhumiwa dhambi zetu, atatusamehe.”

findings.location: (sentence: “It is impossible for God to lie, therefore his Word...”)
findings.source_quote: “It is impossible for God to lie, therefore his Word and promises can always be trusted.”
findings.suggested_fix:
Sahihisha tafsiri ili iwe na maana sawa ya Kiingereza. Pendekezo ndani ya

: “Ni jambo lisilowezekana kwa Mungu kulipuuzia uaminifu au kusema uongo; kwa hivyo Neno lake na ahadi zake daima zinaweza kuaminiwa.” Au kwa ufasaha zaidi: “Mungu hawezi kusema uongo; kwa hivyo Neno lake na ahadi zake daima zinaaminika.”
findings.translation_quote: “Ni vigumu kwa Mungu kulegeza uwongo, kwa hiyo Neno lake na ahadi zake daima zinaweza kuaminiwa.”

findings.source_quote: “But whosoever drinketh of the water that I shall give him shall never thirst; but the water that I shall give him shall be in him a well of water springing up into everlasting life” (John 4:14).
findings.suggested_fix: Ruhusu tafsiri ya mstari wa maandiko iwe wazi na kamilifu. Pendekezo kisichobadilisha ujumbe: “Lakini yeye yeyote atakayekunywa maji nitakayompa hatakasirika kamwe; bali maji nitakayompa yatakuwa ndani yake kisima cha maji kinachomiminika hadi uzima wa milele.” (Yohana 4:14). (Sahihisha maneno madogo kama “yeyote”/“yeyule” na msamiati ili kufuata idiomu ya Kiswahili.)
findings.translation_quote: “Lakini yeyote anayekunywa maji nitakayompa hatakasirika kamwe; bali maji nitakayompa yatakuwa ndani yake kisima cha maji kinachomiminika hadi uzima wa milele” (Yohana 4:14).
